name: IndieTool

sources.title: Homepage — indie-founder directory; Standard plan $29.99 one-time: lifetime listing, dofollow backlink (claimed DR 49), newsletter blast to 1,500+ subs, live in 60s

requirements: Includes: permanent listing, do-follow backlink, no reciprocal badge required, newsletter blast to 1,500+ subscribers, claimed live-in-60-seconds automated indexing
preparation: Product name, URL, short description, logo
workflow: Open https://indietool.io/ and click Get Standard Listing (or /user/signup?accountType=indietool-standard)
Fill the listing (name, URL, description, logo, category)
Listing claimed to be live within ~60 seconds and blasted to the newsletter
watchFor: The pitch is explicitly a backlink/DR play ('Launch Today, Get DR 49+ Backlink') — value is SEO, not audience
Claimed DR 49 is the site's self-reported number
Heavy ad slots and sponsor spots across the page — the product directory doubles as ad inventory
countsAsLive: A product page at indietool.io/indietool/<slug> exists and the product appears in the apps/explore listing
unknowns: Whether featured/trending placement is a separate purchase
